# Phase 29 — Vertical Slice Breakdown

Break the approved milestone into small end-to-end slices. Each slice must list ID, outcome, parent FR/NFR/AC IDs, scope/non-scope, UX/API/data dependencies, file areas, implementation tasks, tests, risks, observability, rollback and Definition of Done. Sequence by dependency and risk. Limit the next proposal to one slice. Request `APPROVE SLICE <ID>`.
